sources.title: [PATCH v7 0/3] media: Add Himax HM1092 mono NIR sensor driver

claims.claim: This adds a V4L2 subdev driver and DT binding for the Himax HM1092, a 1 megapixel monochrome near-infrared image sensor. On laptops it sits behind the IR camera used for face unlock. It speaks a single MIPI CSI-2 data lane and outputs 10-bit RAW. The driver exposes one fixed mode, test patterns, exposure, analogue gain and digital gain controls, pixel-array selection targets and the standard fwnode properties.
